data.action: 单手撑红油纸伞伫立雪地回眸，木屐踩在雪中，哈出一缕白汽，眼神脉脉
data.camera: full body, 3/4 perspective, deep winter perspective
data.description: 【朝武芳乃 · 初雪初霁的红伞回眸】覆盖着厚厚纯白新雪的神社漫长参道石阶上，两排朱红灯笼在雪地中分外夺目。芳乃手撑一把传统的重樱朱红油纸伞，脚踏木屐伫立在积雪中央。她撑伞侧身回眸，银白长发与绯红和服在银装素裹的世界中呈现出极高的视觉对比，呵出的一团淡淡白汽在寒风中化作缱绻的柔情。
data.lighting: 漫天白雪折射出的高纯度清冷白光与红伞内部的朱红暖调
data.location: 大雪初霁的神社参道石阶与朱红鸟居下
data.promptProse: Yoshino turns sideways beneath a traditional red oil-paper umbrella on the deeply snow-covered shrine steps, wearing her current white miko blouse and vermilion hakama with wooden sandals. A little breath cloud forms beside her silver hair. The full-body three-quarter view follows red lantern rows down the long approach. Reflected snow light defines the robe sleeves and step edges, while red umbrella light warms her shaded face and gripping hand.
data.title: 朝武芳乃 · 初雪初霁的红伞回眸
